entries.name: 梨园 TV
entries.description: 央视公开戏曲点播，支持视频与片单导入、收藏和历史续播
entries.descriptionEn: Public opera programs, personal playlists, favorites and resume playback

entries.name: BiliTV
entries.description: 极简哔哩哔哩电视客户端，支持搜索、扫码登录、收藏与观看历史
entries.descriptionEn: Minimal unofficial Bilibili TV client with remote-friendly search, playback, QR login, favorites and watch history.

entries.name: CCTV Live
entries.description: 央视官网播放器与电视频道导航
entries.descriptionEn: Official CCTV website player with TV channel navigation

entries.name: HIFINi TV
entries.description: 基于 HiFiNi 的电视音乐播放器
entries.descriptionEn: HiFiNi music search, shuffle playback and rhythm animation

entries.name: WebTV
entries.description: 电视直播与 M3U 播放器
entries.descriptionEn: Live TV and M3U player

entries.name: ShortVideo TV
entries.description: 遥控器短视频播放器
entries.descriptionEn: Short video player with remote control support

entries.name: 霓虹飞车
entries.description: 三条原创3D赛道、六车两圈竞速；漂移集气、小喷、氮气和山谷跳台，支持遥控器、键盘、扫码手机及pureTV Wi-Fi实体手柄。
entries.descriptionEn: Original 3D kart racing with three circuits, drift charging, nitro boosts and pureTV Wi-Fi controller support

entries.name: 逻辑工坊
entries.description: 在固定接线的电路中选择逻辑门，让三个输入的全部八行真值表同时匹配目标，有限次数手动检查。
entries.descriptionEn: Choose logic gates in a fixed circuit so all eight truth-table rows for three inputs match the target, with a limited number of manual checks.

entries.name: 四则二十四
entries.description: 在绿毡算牌桌用四张数字牌各一次，通过有方向的四则运算与精确分数凑成二十四；六道题包含分支组合、百数迂回与必须使用分数的挑战。
entries.descriptionEn: Use each of four number cards exactly once on a green felt table to make twenty-four with directed arithmetic and exact fractions. Six puzzles include branching expressions, large intermediate values and essential fractions. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 词阶接龙
entries.description: 在公开四字母词库中每步只换一个字母，以有限步数连到目标词，撤销不退还步数。
entries.descriptionEn: Change one letter at a time through a public word list to reach the target within a limited move budget; undo does not refund moves.

entries.name: 天台疾跑
entries.description: 自动奔跑穿越天台，抓准时机跳过箱子和缺口，按住下蹲通过悬梁。
entries.descriptionEn: Run across rooftops, time jumps over crates and gaps, and hold crouch to pass under beams.

entries.name: 渡河跃步
entries.description: 穿越车道并借木筏渡河，在有限生命和时间内抵达不同家位。
entries.descriptionEn: Cross traffic and ride moving logs to reach distinct home docks within limited lives and time.

entries.name: 星阵防线
entries.description: 横移躲避敌弹，持续射击下降编队并使用两枚穿透弹；掩体会损毁，在敌阵越线前清空全部目标。
entries.descriptionEn: Move sideways to dodge hostile fire, shoot descending formations, and use two piercing rounds while destructible cover protects the defense line.

entries.name: 环轨炮台
entries.description: 旋转中央炮台持续瞄准射击，拦截沿轨逼近的目标；两次短时护盾只能吸收接触范围内的来袭者。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate a central turret and fire at approaching orbital targets, using two brief shields that absorb only enemies touching their range.

entries.name: 口袋果岭
entries.description: 调整击球角度和力度，让球绕过障碍或借墙反弹，以低速入杯；杆数有限，球停稳后再击。
entries.descriptionEn: Choose angle and power to navigate obstacles and bank off walls, reaching the cup at low speed within the stroke limit.

entries.name: 球道击柱
entries.description: 调整角度和力度投球，通过实际球瓶与瓶间碰撞清空三种阵型；有限球数，滚动结束后再瞄准。
entries.descriptionEn: Aim and choose power to clear three pin formations through ball–pin and pin–pin collisions, with limited throws and aiming between rolls.

entries.name: 王车合围
entries.description: 用白王和白车限制黑王的合法落点，在手数上限内将杀；避免两王相邻、丢车和逼和。
entries.descriptionEn: Use a king and rook to restrict the opposing king and deliver checkmate within the move limit, avoiding adjacent kings, rook loss, and stalemate.

entries.name: 二元织格
entries.description: 填入0和1，使每行每列数量各半、没有连续三个相同数字，且同行与同列各不重复；保留锁定线索。
entries.descriptionEn: Fill zeros and ones with balanced rows and columns, no three identical digits in a row, and no duplicate rows or columns; preserve locked clues.

entries.name: 四格岛群
entries.description: 每区选出四格I、L、T或S形，所有黑格连通且不能形成2×2黑块，相接区域的四格形状必须不同。
entries.descriptionEn: Choose an I, L, T, or S tetromino in every region; connect all black cells, avoid 2×2 blocks, and give touching regions different shapes.

entries.name: 矩形图册
entries.description: 用两角划出矩形覆盖整个网格，每个矩形恰含一个数字且面积相符；可删除重画，重叠区域不能放置。
entries.descriptionEn: Draw rectangles from two corners to cover the grid, each containing exactly one clue equal to its area; remove and redraw regions without overlap.

entries.name: 彩径连点
entries.description: 给网格设色，用互不交叉的单一路径连接每对同号端点并覆盖全盘，不能分叉或形成独立环。
entries.descriptionEn: Color the grid to connect matching numbered endpoints with disjoint simple paths covering every cell, without branches or detached cycles.

entries.name: 舰队账册
entries.description: 依据行列数量与舰船长度清单标注船海，舰船必须笔直且互不接触；保留固定线索并完成全部格子。
entries.descriptionEn: Mark ships and sea from row and column totals and the fleet-length list; keep ships straight and separated, preserve clues, and complete every cell.

entries.name: 光室布灯
entries.description: 布灯照亮全部白格，灯光不能互相照见，并满足每个编号墙的相邻灯数；编辑后手动检查。
entries.descriptionEn: Place lamps to illuminate every white cell without lamps seeing one another, and match each numbered wall’s adjacent lamp count.

entries.name: 岛海墨图
entries.description: 划分数字岛屿和连通海域，每岛恰有一个面积线索，海域不能出现2×2方块；完整填图后手动检查。
entries.descriptionEn: Build numbered islands of the exact area and one connected sea, with one clue per island and no 2×2 sea blocks; check the completed grid manually.

entries.name: 去重留白
entries.description: 涂黑部分数字，让白格行列不重复、黑格不相邻，且所有白格保持连通；用有限检查次数完成留白谜题。
entries.descriptionEn: Shade digits so white cells have no row or column repeats, shaded cells never touch orthogonally, and all white cells remain connected.

entries.name: 交叉数和
entries.description: 填写1至9，使每个横纵连续白格段的数字不重复且总和符合线索；固定数字不可改，完整提交限三次错误。
entries.descriptionEn: Fill digits 1–9 so each horizontal and vertical run has distinct digits and matches its clue sum; preserve fixed digits and avoid three incorrect checks.

entries.name: 旋盘五子
entries.description: 每回合先落一子再旋转一个棋盘象限，旋转后连成五子获胜；同时五连与满盘平局需要重试。
entries.descriptionEn: Place a stone, then rotate a board quadrant each turn; make five after rotation, while simultaneous lines or a full-board draw require a retry.

entries.name: 围子夺星
entries.description: 观察棋块的气，落子围住对手并率先提满四子；遵守自杀禁入与简单劫，控制手数和停手。
entries.descriptionEn: Read liberties and surround opposing groups to capture four stones first, with suicide prevention, simple ko, and a limited number of turns.

entries.name: 口袋接龙
entries.description: 在四列牌与两个暂存位之间逐张搬牌，按异色递减叠放，再按花色递增归位；撤销不退步数。
entries.descriptionEn: Move single cards through four tableau columns and two free cells, stack descending alternating colors, and build suit foundations within the move budget.

entries.name: 叠牌花园
entries.description: 观察双层明牌，配对上方无遮挡且至少一侧开放的同类数字花牌；安排消除顺序，避免死局。
entries.descriptionEn: Match equal visible tiles with no tile above and at least one open side; plan the order across two layers to avoid a deadlock.

entries.name: 骨牌接龙
entries.description: 明牌双六骨牌接龙，选择端点匹配牌面；无牌可接时摸牌或跳过，堵局比较剩余点数。
entries.descriptionEn: Open-hand double-six dominoes: match either chain end, draw or pass when blocked, and compare remaining pips in a blocked game.

entries.name: 取石回合
entries.description: 每回合从一堆中取走石子，判断普通与取末石负两种规则，和使用公开最优策略的对手较量。
entries.descriptionEn: Remove stones from one pile per turn, master both normal and last-stone-loses rules, and challenge an opponent using a public optimal strategy.

entries.name: 比较器工坊
entries.description: 在有限层数与比较器库存内连接排序线网，检查全部二值输入，利用失败见证逐步修正网络。
entries.descriptionEn: Build a sorting network within its layer and comparator limits, test every binary input, and use failing examples to refine the design.

entries.name: 夜桥接力
entries.description: 在两岸营地安排持灯旅人过桥，每次一至两人、按较慢者计算用时；六支队伍逐步挑战紧凑排程，新增三关需恰好达到最优预算。
entries.descriptionEn: Arrange torch-bearing travelers between two camps, sending one or two people across at the slower pace. Six groups build toward exact scheduling; the three new levels require an optimal total time. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 渡河守则
entries.description: 安排有限船位往返两岸，避免无人看守的冲突组合，用公开规则把所有物品安全运到对岸。
entries.descriptionEn: Plan crossings with limited boat capacity, prevent conflicts on unattended banks, and ferry every item safely across using fully public rules.

entries.name: 车阵出口
entries.description: 在拥挤车阵中沿车身方向逐格挪车，利用有限撤销腾出通路，将目标车辆驶出右侧出口。
entries.descriptionEn: Slide vehicles along their axes to clear a crowded lot, manage limited undo tickets, and guide the target car through the right-side exit.

entries.name: 点线围格
entries.description: 选择边线围成方格，利用得格续手掌握回合节奏，与公开规则的对手争夺最后一格。
entries.descriptionEn: Draw edges to complete boxes, keep your turn after each capture, and outscore a public-policy opponent through careful timing.

entries.name: 播子棋盘
entries.description: 沿棋穴逐粒播种，利用入仓续手与对穴吃子争取过半种子，并应对规则公开的对手。
entries.descriptionEn: Sow seeds around the pits, earn extra turns in your store, and capture opposite seeds to secure a majority against a public-policy opponent.

entries.name: 六角连线
entries.description: 在六角棋盘上落子连接左右两岸，识别六邻接通路并阻挡试图连通上下边的公开规则对手。
entries.descriptionEn: Connect the left and right edges of a hexagonal board using its six-neighbor paths while blocking a public-policy opponent aiming from top to bottom.

entries.name: 跳吃棋径
entries.description: 在六路跳棋残局中强制连跳吃子，保护兵并升为王棋，遵循合法移动击败公开规则的对手。
entries.descriptionEn: Solve six-by-six draughts endgames with mandatory captures and continuous jumps. Promote men to kings and defeat an opponent with a public deterministic policy.

entries.name: 四子列阵
entries.description: 在七列棋盘中让棋子按重力落下，与会预判落点的对手较量，率先横、竖或斜连四子。
entries.descriptionEn: Drop pieces into seven gravity-fed columns and outplay a look-ahead opponent. Connect four horizontally, vertically or diagonally.

entries.name: 数字汇聚
entries.description: 滑动棋盘合并相同数字，每次滑动只合并一次；管理确定生成的新砖和有限撤销，在步数内达成32、64、128目标。
entries.descriptionEn: Slide equal numbers together, with each tile merging at most once per move. Manage deterministic spawns and limited undo tickets to reach 32, 64 and 128 within the move limits.

entries.name: 弹板清砖
entries.description: 左右移动挡板接球，用落点控制反弹方向，守住三条生命并清除三组不同耐久的砖块。
entries.descriptionEn: Move the paddle to return the ball and aim rebounds with its contact point. Clear three brick layouts while preserving your three lives.

entries.name: 叠塔工匠
entries.description: 抓准石板重叠时机逐层叠塔，只留下重叠部分；六处工地包含匀速、变速、信号停走与阵风节律，最高挑战十四层天际塔。
entries.descriptionEn: Drop moving slabs when they overlap the tower, keeping only the overlapping area. Six building sites vary steady motion, acceleration, stop signals and gust rhythms, culminating in a fourteen-floor tower. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 果园游蛇
entries.description: 预排下一拍的转向，绕开石墙与蛇身收集果实；使用有限刹车规划路线，完成三座果园。
entries.descriptionEn: Queue the next turn, collect fruit and avoid rocks and your growing tail. Spend limited brake tokens to plan a safe route through three orchards.

entries.name: 数塔天际
entries.description: 按照行列数字不重复和边缘可见塔数线索，完成逐渐扩大的数字天际棋盘。
entries.descriptionEn: Complete growing number grids using nonrepeating rows and columns and the visible tower counts along their edges.

entries.name: 纹码破译
entries.description: 利用位置正确和颜色正确的数量反馈，在有限尝试内破解允许重复图形的四位密码。
entries.descriptionEn: Solve a four-symbol code that may contain repeats using exact-position and misplaced-symbol feedback within a limited number of guesses.

entries.name: 记忆陈列
entries.description: 记住短暂亮出的图形与编号，在有限错配次数内翻开全部相同展品。支持电视遥控器与局域网手机手柄。
entries.descriptionEn: Remember briefly revealed symbols and numbers, then uncover every matching pair within the mistake limit. Supports TV remotes and a local-network phone controller.

entries.name: 雷纹勘探
entries.description: 依据周围八格的雷数线索，逐步勘明所有安全格；旗标只作推理笔记，探到雷即失败。三张可凭公开线索推理的地图，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Use visible neighboring mine counts to uncover every safe cell on three logically solvable boards. Flags are notes; reveal a mine and the round ends.

entries.name: 像素线索
entries.description: 根据公开的行列连续段数字涂出像素图，叉号仅作留白笔记；在三张逐渐增大的画纸上匹配全部线索，分别管理60、90、120秒有效时间，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Fill pixel pictures using public row and column run clues. Crosses are optional notes; solve three increasingly large boards within 60, 90 and 120 seconds of active play.

entries.name: 星盘皇后
entries.description: 在六、七、八阶星盘上摆放互不攻击的皇后，遵守固定皇后和禁放格限制；允许调整并观察行、列、对角线冲突，用三次手动检查完成布局，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Arrange non-attacking queens on six-, seven- and eight-order boards while respecting fixed queens and blocked cells. Inspect row, column and diagonal conflicts, then submit within three check attempts.

entries.name: 马步巡游
entries.description: 按国际象棋马的跳法巡游棋盘，每个可走格只能访问一次；规划三种不同棋盘的完整路线，管理三张回退券，避免走入死路，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Tour three different boards with chess-knight jumps, visiting every available square exactly once. Plan a complete route and use three limited undo tokens to recover from dead ends.

entries.name: 环塔迁移
entries.description: 在三根塔柱之间搬运圆环，每次只能移动顶环，小环必须放在大环上；用有限搬动次数将整塔迁到目标柱，挑战三环、四环与五环布局，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Transfer a tower of rings between three pegs, moving only the top ring and never placing a larger ring on a smaller one. Solve three-, four- and five-ring towers within their move budgets.

entries.name: 滑格归序
entries.description: 移动九宫格中的空格，让八块数字瓷砖按顺序归位；管理有限滑动次数，撤销恢复棋盘但不退步数。三种独立初始布局，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Move the blank space in a 3x3 board to arrange eight numbered tiles in order. Solve three starting layouts within their slide budgets; undo restores the board without refunding moves.

entries.name: 三角跳珠
entries.description: 在十五孔三角棋盘上，沿六个方向跳过相邻棋珠并移除它，最终只留一珠；管理三次撤回机会，三个不同起始空孔，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Jump over adjacent pegs in six directions on a fifteen-hole triangular board until only one remains. Solve three different starting vacancies with three limited undo tokens.

entries.name: 石箱归位
entries.description: 在三座庭院里推动石箱，让每个石座都被占据；只能推、不能拉，步行不扣推力，撤回恢复位置但不返还推力。管理有限推动额度，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Push stone crates onto every socket in three courtyards. You can push but cannot pull; walking is free, while undo restores positions without refunding the limited push budget.

entries.name: 翻面棋局
entries.description: 挑战三道6×6翻面棋残局，用八方向夹击翻转棋子，与确定性电脑对手轮流落子；无合法落点时让行，终局以棋子多数获胜，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Play three 6x6 Reversi endgames against a deterministic opponent. Bracket and flip discs in eight directions, pass only with no legal move, and finish with the majority of discs.

entries.name: 量杯转运
entries.description: 在三只不同容量的量杯间倾倒，每次必须倒满接收杯或倒空来源杯；保持总水量守恒，在有限倾倒次数内让三杯同时达到公开目标。三个配额关卡，支持手机扫码操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Pour conserved water between three jugs of different capacities. Every transfer fills the destination or empties the source; meet all three visible target amounts within a finite pour budget across three puzzles.

entries.name: 染色连疆
entries.description: 选择染料扩展左上角连通区域，在有限次数内统一全图；只沿四边连通，撤回会恢复地图但不返还染料次数，三张公开地图，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Flood a connected territory from the top-left corner using a finite dye budget. Four-neighbor expansion, three public maps, and undo that restores the board without refunding moves; phone directional and two action zones.

entries.name: 序栈货运
entries.description: 用单件吊机和三个后进先出的货栈，按公开货单顺序出港；管理有限容量与搬动额度，三次错序出货失败。三个调度关卡，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Operate a single-cargo crane and three LIFO storage bays to ship visible manifests in order. Three puzzles with finite capacity, limited handling moves and three wrong-order attempts; phone directional and two action zones.

entries.name: 焦距实验室
entries.description: 原创单人光学益智游戏：移动透镜和屏幕，调节光阑，让实像的清晰度与亮度同时达标。三个光台各有两张底片，分别管理曝光电量与调整额度；手机方向区和上下双操作区控制。
entries.descriptionEn: Original single-player optics puzzle. Move a lens and screen, adjust the iris, and satisfy separate real-image clarity and brightness requirements. Three benches each contain two plates with independent exposure and adjustment budgets.

entries.name: 异形装箱
entries.description: 在装箱工作台移动、旋转有限零件，装入六种异形货仓，并保留指定零件的完整直线出库通道；新增中央障碍、多门分流与岔路转运任务。
entries.descriptionEn: Move and rotate a finite set of pieces on a packing desk to fit six shaped containers while preserving straight extraction routes. New jobs add central obstacles, several exit doors and alternative routes. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 万花钥匙
entries.description: 把有限图符摆进源扇区，旋转并选择万花阶数，让整圈镜像钥匙与目标完全一致；核对左右交换、朝向与空格后验收，四次错误即失败，无倒计时。
entries.descriptionEn: Place and rotate limited glyphs in one source wedge, choose a symmetry order, and match the complete mirrored key. Check swapped columns, quarter turns and empty sockets before submitting. Four rejected submissions end the round; there is no deadline.

entries.name: 纹幕校准
entries.description: 滑动并旋转两层周期纹幕，让五个测点的当前明暗同时符合目标；参考可见定位标记，在限时与验收次数内完成三种光学校准。
entries.descriptionEn: Slide and rotate two periodic masks until all five current brightness checks match their targets together. Use visible fiducial guides to complete three optical calibrations within the time and submission limits.

entries.name: 解线工
entries.description: 沿轨道移动接线端子，保持金属线夹整组联动，消除直线电缆的非法交叉与端子重合；三种工作台，最后一次调整也能完成接线。
entries.descriptionEn: Slide terminals along their rails and move linked clamps together to untangle straight cables. Remove illegal crossings and coincident ports across three workbenches; even the last adjustment can complete the wiring.

entries.name: 影形铸坊
entries.description: 旋转金属工件与侧向光源，覆盖全部青色目标格并避开禁区；两种控制独立调整，最后一次机会也能完成铸影。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate a compact metal assembly and its side light to cover cyan target samples without touching amber forbidden samples. Direction, height and overlap matter; twelve rotations per blueprint.

entries.name: 视差天际
entries.description: 移动近远两层建筑，在两个观察点同时对齐天际线与屋顶标记；小心只匹配主视角的错觉，撤销移动不会返还容错次数。
entries.descriptionEn: Slide near and far building plates to match both skylines and visible roof landmarks. A convincing front view can hide a wrong far plate; undo preserves failed submissions.

entries.name: 压力封装
entries.description: 控制加热与泄压，让三种包装依次在目标压力内完成密封；松手后的余热仍会改变压力。
entries.descriptionEn: Hold heat and vent controls to seal three packages within their pressure bands. Residual heat keeps changing pressure after release.

entries.name: 冰面刹停
entries.description: 左右推动惯性货橇，按住 A 放下冰爪，只有结霜带提供额外制动；完整停入逐渐收窄的交付区并驻留，避开冰面边界和急刹造成的货损。
entries.descriptionEn: Push an inertial cargo sled and hold A to lower the ice claw. Extra braking works only on frost bands. Settle the complete sled inside three narrowing delivery zones while avoiding the edges and cargo damage. Three scenarios; Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 旋环锁匠
entries.description: 左右拨转三层锁环，按住 A 推进、B 退回；进入核心取得钥匙，再将完整钥匙带出，避开碰壁造成的耐久损失和阻力。
entries.descriptionEn: Turn three geared rings, hold A to move inward and B to retreat. Retrieve the core key and guide its wider head back through the gaps while preserving durability. Three locks; Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 节拍闸道
entries.description: 先排方向和等待，按固定节拍穿过周期闸门；在拍数预算内收齐标记并抵达出口，B 可撤回未执行的队尾命令。
entries.descriptionEn: Queue directions and waits, pass periodic gates on each beat, collect all markers and reach the exit within the beat budget. Undo removes only the unexecuted tail command. Three maps; Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 双线节律
entries.description: 一线持续按住，另一线按节拍点按，交替编织并保持连续；完成三个节奏关卡。
entries.descriptionEn: Hold one thread while tapping the other on the beat, alternate roles and maintain continuity across three rhythm charts. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 脉冲储库
entries.description: 按住收集有限脉冲，选择档位向顺序门锁放电；控制储能溢出和热峰，开启四门并保留终储备，完成三种供能关卡。
entries.descriptionEn: Hold to collect a finite pulse supply, select a dose and discharge into sequential locks. Control overflow and heat peaks, open four locks and retain the final energy reserve across three supply scenarios. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 窗口装配
entries.description: 在工厂操作台抓取、旋转并投送零件，趁快门开放完成连续装配；六张工单包含反向传送、窄窗快装与夜班错相协同。
entries.descriptionEn: Grab, rotate and deliver parts through open shutters on a factory console. Six work orders introduce reverse belts, narrow windows and staggered night-shift shutters while requiring consecutive correct assemblies. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 影窗快门
entries.description: 移动取景框并切换横竖画幅，避开遮光纸带，让三片剪影完整入窗并依序拍成目标；用有限胶片完成三组影窗作品。
entries.descriptionEn: Move and rotate the aperture to photograph three complete, correctly aligned silhouettes while avoiding an opaque paper strip. Match ordered targets with limited film across three scenes. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 齿轮同刻
entries.description: 调节齿轮列的离合与制动，在有限调节次数内让所有指针于预约时间窗中持续对齐目标；挑战三种齿比结构。
entries.descriptionEn: Engage or brake gear trains within a limited adjustment budget. Keep every pointer aligned throughout the appointment hold across three gear layouts. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 共振浮桥
entries.description: 调节三块浮桥的频率和相位，派遣行人在持续安全接触时过桥；控制共振增幅，完成三个渡口关卡。
entries.descriptionEn: Tune the frequency and phase of three floating bridge slabs. Dispatch pedestrians who cross only after sustained safe contact, while keeping resonance under control. Three crossing scenarios. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 四季蓄水
entries.description: 根据四季天气预报向居民、农田和生态河流配水；撤销尚未提交的计划，守住居民每季用水底线，并分别完成三方年度目标。
entries.descriptionEn: Allocate reservoir water to residents, farms and the ecological river using four-season forecasts. Undo uncommitted plans, protect seasonal minimums and meet each group's annual target. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 传粉契约
entries.description: 调度两支蜂群，在有限花期和前置任务间完成授粉；途中改派并及时返巢恢复耐力，完成三关花园契约。
entries.descriptionEn: Guide two bee groups through timed blooms and prerequisite fields, redirect flights and return to the hive to recover stamina across three garden contracts. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 分流沙漏
entries.description: 开关共享料斗并旋转两块挡片，把连续落沙分给三只计量杯；在途沙束保留已确定的路线，耗尽沙量后让三杯都处于目标容差内且没有溢出。
entries.descriptionEn: Toggle the shared hopper and rotate two deflectors to distribute sand between three cups. Packets keep the route chosen on contact; drain the available sand with every cup inside its target tolerance and no spill. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 港口配重
entries.description: 按指定顺序装卸六件货物，在吊机作业时移动配重控制船体横摇；保持货物可取，完成四件交付后让两件出口货物稳定离港。
entries.descriptionEn: Load and unload six cargo units in a specified order while moving ballast to control vessel roll. Keep required cargo accessible, deliver four units and stabilize the ship with its two export units aboard. Simplified crane and roll game with a Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 电芯交换
entries.description: 在断电窗口中交换六枚不同电量与内阻的电芯，为两组负载切换串联或并联；按阶段完成供电任务，同时保留电量余裕并避免电芯或负载过热。
entries.descriptionEn: Exchange six cells with different charge and internal resistance during safe off windows. Select series or parallel wiring for two loads, complete their staged power requests, and manage charge and temperature. Simplified circuit game with a Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 装配厨房
entries.description: 安排煮、冷却与装盒三个共享工位并行工作，切换风速掌握温度，在保温时限与关门前按指定顺序交付三份订单；错温、错序或过期的食物会退回重做并累计失误。
entries.descriptionEn: Coordinate shared cooking, cooling and packing stations. Adjust fan speed, manage food temperature and holding limits, and deliver three orders in the required sequence before closing. Incorrect or expired food is discarded and the order returns for rework. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 防火带
entries.description: 用有限行动点提前清理防火带，依据固定变风与累积热量阻断同时蔓延的山火；保护全部村落与至少七成存活森林，清理本身也会减少林木。
entries.descriptionEn: Plan firebreaks with limited action points. Anticipate changing wind and accumulated heat as fire spreads simultaneously, protect every village and retain at least seventy percent of the original forest. Clearing also counts as forest loss. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 气闸值守
entries.description: 在待援舱、气闸与安全舱之间安排三组人员，权衡慢回收保氧和快排赶期限；管理有限储罐与共享泵，及时封堵漏点并满足最终储氧底线。
entries.descriptionEn: Schedule three groups through an airlock. Balance slow oxygen recovery against fast venting and individual deadlines, manage a finite reservoir and shared pump, and seal the leak while preserving the required final reserve. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 温室旋钮
entries.description: 通过延迟生效的通风、遮阳和滴灌控制调节共享温湿度与土壤水分，管理有限水量，使三种作物分别达到成熟度并避免枯死。
entries.descriptionEn: Adjust ventilation, shade and drip irrigation with delayed controls. Manage shared climate and limited water so all three crops reach their own maturity requirements without dying. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 逐日供电
entries.description: 随日照与阴影调整太阳板朝向，为不同优先级的设备供电；管理有限电池与温度，完成昼夜周期及各设备的独立供电配额。
entries.descriptionEn: Orient a solar panel through changing daylight and shadows, supply devices in priority order, and manage battery energy and temperature to meet each device's quota through the night. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 箭田收获
entries.description: 设置单向箭头并播种，让种子覆盖所有目标田块且不重复、不进入禁地；传播期间箭头不可修改。
entries.descriptionEn: Route seeds along one-way arrows to cover every target field exactly once without entering forbidden ground. Arrows are locked during propagation. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 三角拼域
entries.description: 旋转与镜像三角彩砖，让共享边同色并形成指定数量的红绿蓝色域；三关各有有限步数和90秒时限，每次操作都消耗一步，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate and mirror triangular color tiles to match shared edges and exact red, green and blue region counts. Three original puzzles use charged moves and a 90-second limit; scan the TV code for single-player phone control. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 沙丘数列
entries.description: 选择一行或一列，保持段内顺序压实数字石，不合并、不跨岩柱；蛇形读数严格递增且全部空洞吻合目标才能获胜，撤销恢复原石原格但不退已用步数或时间，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Compact one selected row or column without merging or crossing fixed pillars. Keep physical stone order within each segment and achieve both a strictly increasing snake readout and the exact target holes. Undo restores stone positions without refunding successful moves or active time. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 环线果园
entries.description: 在格点之间铺设一条连通闭环，经过必经果树、避开禁水花坛并满足数字区域的边数提示；带编号管件可铺拆和精确撤销，剩余库存允许，须主动启动水泵，三次错误或90秒结束，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Build one connected irrigation loop through required trees, avoid forbidden flower vertices, and satisfy exact region-edge clues; unhinted regions remain unconstrained. Place or remove unique physical pipes, undo the exact edit, then start PUMP explicitly. Three wrong starts or 90 active seconds end a round. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 邻接铸造
entries.description: 交换七格金属块，满足各自精确邻接配方并按固定方向优先级将热流导向铸模，再主动提交；三张固定布局、精确编号撤销与90秒有效时间，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Swap unique metal tiles on seven hexagonal cells. Satisfy every exact local neighbor recipe and route heat from furnace to mold using fixed world-direction outlet priorities, then submit explicitly. Exact-ID undo, three wrong submissions and a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 双岛联结
entries.description: 按桥牌的直线长度与目标颜色连结岛屿，避开交叉并用尽所有独立桥牌组成连通网络；支持原片撤销，三关固定布局与90秒时限，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Place unique bridge pieces between islands using exact straight-line lengths and matching destination colors. Use every piece to form one connected, noncrossing network; undo restores the same physical piece without refunding time or errors. Three fixed puzzles with a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 隐墙测绘
entries.description: 依据每行通路格数与最短边数，用有限探针推断4×4隐藏墙体，再提交安全且长度正确的路线；三关固定布局，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Infer a hidden 4x4 wall map from public row counts, exact shortest edge distance and limited one-cell probes. Mark and submit a safe route of the required length. Three fixed puzzles with a 90-second active timer; three wrong submissions after probe exhaustion end a round. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 奇偶花圃
entries.description: 用十字与斜角喷头翻转4×4花圃，让目标花形和标记花的直接浇水偶数条件同时成立；重复浇水不退水，三道有限水量谜题，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Match a public 4x4 flower pattern using cross and diagonal watering nozzles. Marked flowers must be open with an even direct watering count; repeated sprays never refund water. Three puzzles with finite water and a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 砝码账本
entries.description: 将六枚独立编号的砝码分配到三个共享盘，同时配平三条整数衡式；预选拿取、有限搬动与真实撤销，三道公开谜题，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Allocate six uniquely identified weights across three shared pans to balance all integer equations and empty storage. Three public puzzles use limited relocations, explicit lever coefficients, pickup previews and undo that preserves elapsed time. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 路径刻印
entries.description: 在5×5石板上规划不重复的路径，按入边条件收集方向符号，在出口提交与目标完全一致的刻印；三道公开谜题，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Trace a non-repeating route across a public 5x5 board. Entry-side conditions emit direction glyphs; submit the exact ordered target at the exit. Three puzzles with whole-route clear, persistent failure history and a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 热流滑翔
entries.description: 驾驶无引擎滑翔翼利用热流穿过有序观测圈，使用空气刹车与襟翼管理能量，满足位置、速度与姿态后实际降落；三条航线，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Fly an unpowered glider through ordered observation rings using visible thermals, wind, airbrakes and flaps, then satisfy every runway landing limit. Three public courses and a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 折光工坊
entries.description: 在双花窗工作台翻叠半透明彩片，用轮廓和叠色匹配六幅目标；新增留白与不对称层序谜题，支持有限折叠、撤销修正和手机扫码操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Fold translucent colored tiles on a twin-window workbench to match six stained-glass targets. New negative-space and asymmetric layering puzzles include undo, limited folds and a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 灯塔节拍
entries.description: 观察方向与短长灯号，再按节拍真实按住并松开按钮，依次点亮三座灯塔；两次主动重听、有限失误与90秒有效时间，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Observe directional short and long lighthouse signals, then reproduce their timing with real button holds to light all three beacons. Limited replay credits and a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 磁极仓库
entries.description: 切换磁极，隔空吸引或排斥编号货箱；处理墙体遮挡与同步移动，在有限行动内把每箱送到对应货位，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Switch magnetic polarity to attract and repel numbered crates into their matching docks, with simultaneous movement, walls and a limited action budget. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 回声探图
entries.description: 在有限照明下发射声呐测绘暗室，控制脚步噪声避开巡逻机，收集信标后返回入口，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Map dark corridors with timed sonar, manage battery and patrol noise, collect every beacon and return to the entrance. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 拉索桥梁
entries.description: 在蓝图测绘桌搭建拉索桥，在材料预算内应对六种塔高、跨度和载荷；观察索线张力与桥面变形，失败后修改原方案，让货车完整驶过桥面。
entries.descriptionEn: Build cable bridges on a blueprint drafting desk within a material budget. Six sites vary tower height, span and load; inspect tension and deck deformation, repair failed designs and carry the truck safely across. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 潮汐闸门
entries.description: 调节两级船闸水位，安全开启闸门，把货船送往高水位出口；管理水量守恒、溢流和搁浅，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Adjust finite chamber water levels, operate interlocked gates and guide cargo boats uphill through two canal locks. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 分岔调度
entries.description: 切换道岔、错开放行，把双向货车送到同色站台，管理追尾风险与累计延误，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Route freight trains to matching platforms, operate occupied-track locks and schedule departures from two waiting gates. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 镜光接力
entries.description: 在光学实验台旋转镜片与分光模块，让彩色光束抵达接收器；六关涵盖反射、分色、双光源、双模块与多路合光，支持手机扫码操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate mirrors and color-splitting modules on an optical bench to illuminate receivers with exact colors. Six levels cover reflection, splitting, dual sources, dual modules and merging several light paths. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 引力快递
entries.description: 驾驶惯性小艇绕行引力星体，管理燃料并完成三次星际配送，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Pilot an inertial courier ship, manage fuel and deliver three parcels around gravity sources. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 孤胆枪手 TV
entries.description: 工业基地异形群潮单人射击，三关战役、五种武器与手机扫码操作
entries.descriptionEn: Single-player industrial-base alien combat with three campaign stages, five weapons and a LAN phone controller

entries.name: 极品二手车
entries.description: 随机车况与机械故障的三维赛车，支持手机扫码一至两人竞速和 AI 对手
entries.descriptionEn: 3D racing with randomized used cars, mechanical failures and one or two LAN phone players alongside AI opponents

entries.name: Cozy Island TV
entries.description: 原创岛屿生活，支持采集、钓鱼、布置和手机扫码双人游玩
entries.descriptionEn: Original island life with gathering, fishing, decorating and LAN phone play

entries.name: Coast Kart TV
entries.description: 原创卡丁车竞速，支持漂移、道具和手机扫码双人分屏
entries.descriptionEn: Original kart racing with drifting, items and split-screen LAN phone play

entries.name: Super Mario TV
entries.description: 8 世界 32 关平台冒险，支持手机扫码单人或双人轮流
entries.descriptionEn: 32-course platform adventure with LAN phone controllers and alternating turns

entries.description: 16 关金字塔跳跃冒险，支持手机扫码单人或双人轮流
entries.descriptionEn: 16-stage pyramid adventure with LAN phone controllers and alternating turns

entries.description: 8 区域 32 关横版冒险，支持手机扫码单人或双人轮流
entries.descriptionEn: 32-stage island adventure with LAN phone controllers and alternating turns

entries.description: 经典俄罗斯方块，支持手机扫码单人或双人比拼
entries.descriptionEn: Classic falling-block puzzle with one or two LAN phone controllers

entries.name: Magic Jewelry TV
entries.description: 经典三宝石连锁消除，支持手机扫码单人或双人比拼
entries.descriptionEn: Classic three-gem chain matching with one or two LAN phone controllers

entries.name: Jackal TV
entries.description: 独立重写的六关吉普车营救游戏，支持手机扫码双人合作
entries.descriptionEn: Independently rewritten six-stage jeep rescue with two LAN phone controllers

entries.description: 独立重写的 35 关坦克大战，支持手机扫码双人合作
entries.descriptionEn: Independently rewritten 35-stage tank defense with two LAN phone controllers

entries.descriptionEn: Browse, install and check TV app updates directly on your television
